body:
Talia Benson: Heads up: we’re running controlled multi-region failover windows next week as part of the “Regional failover automation upgrade” reliability program.

Goal: validate the new trigger + orchestrator path (monitor-only → canary → progressive) with strict guardrails, and capture learnings for runbooks/dashboards.

Planned windows (PT):
• Tue 4/30 10:00–11:00
• Thu 5/2 15:00–16:00
(If we hit a stop condition we’ll abort early and reschedule. No other changes are bundled with this.)

Scope/blast radius (initial):
• Hosted API only
• Low-risk slice (canary % of traffic) + limited route/model set
• Dedicated + Private deployments are NOT included
• Feature flag gated (failover automation remains off by default outside the window)

What you may see (expected/acceptable during the window):
• Short-lived routing shifts between regions
• Brief tail latency increase on impacted routes (cross-region hop)
• A small bump in retries / streaming reconnects
• Some “degraded but available” behavior (load shedding / tighter timeouts) if we intentionally induce impairment

What you should NOT see (page/raise immediately):
• Broad 5xx across regions
• Persistent elevated error rates (> ~2–3 mins) on unrelated routes
• Unexpected impact to Dedicated tenants
• Any sign of flappy failover loops (repeated region switching)

Where to report issues:
• If customer-visible: post in #incidents and tag @Rafael Mendes + @Connor O'Brien (use /incident if you think it’s real)
• If internal-only observations: reply in this thread with links/screenshots (dashboard panel link is best)
• Support escalations: route through Dev/Support in #support (don’t promise anything externally; we’ll use the comms template)

Docs:
• Game day plan: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ONCALL/Controlled+Failover+Game+Day+Plan+2025Q2
• Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ONCALL/Automated+Region+Failover+Runbook
• Dashboards (WIP): https://grafana.redwoodinference.com/d/failover/region-health

Roles (for both windows):
• IC: Rafael Mendes
• Release/flag owner: Connor O'Brien
• Routing lead: Mina Haddad
• SLO/alerts: Aisha Bello
• Infra/capacity on-call: Irene Choi

Please avoid landing unrelated high-risk networking/routing changes during the window unless coordinated with Connor.

:eyes: If you own a service that depends on routing policy store / edge / capacity signals, keep an eye on your alerts and be ready to drop notes here.

—
Rafael Mendes: Adding: we’ll start in monitor-only for ~10–15 min, then canary % failover, then progressive expansion if stable. Manual override will be on-call-only, and we have hold-down timers to prevent flapping.

Connor O'Brien: Confirmed we’ll have a change freeze on routing policy pushes during each window (except the controlled steps). If you *must* merge a routing-related hotfix, ping me first.

Aisha Bello: FYI we’re temporarily adjusting paging thresholds for a couple of failover-specific alerts during the window to reduce noise. If you see burn-rate alerts firing outside the expected slice, that’s a big signal → post in #incidents.

Dev Patel: For Support/CS: please don’t send proactive notes to customers unless we ask. We have an internal macro + status page language if anything customer-visible happens. If you get inbound questions, route to #support and link the incident thread.

Mina Haddad: Q for everyone: please sanity-check your dashboards’ region filters. A few panels default to us-east; during the test traffic will shift and you’ll miss the effect if you’re pinned.

Irene Choi: Capacity note: we’ve reserved headroom in the target region for the window. If you see unexpected GPU pool saturation warnings in non-target regions, flag ASAP.

Neha Kapoor: Thanks all. Reminder: stop conditions are real stop conditions. If anything looks unsafe, we pause and learn—success is proving we can abort cleanly.

Incident Bot: Reminder: During the controlled failover window, use #incidents for any customer-visible impact. Runbook: https://confluence.redwoodinference.com/display/ONCALL/Automated+Region+Failover+Runbook (Commands: `@incident-bot failover status`, `@incident-bot failover audit <region>`)

Talia Benson: One more thing—if you can be an observer, great. We’ll share a short readout after Thu’s window with what we saw + follow-ups. Reply here if you want to be added to the observer list.
